## About the Event

METALLON MULTIVERSEis an annual students’ technical event hosted by the Department of Metallurgical and Materials Engineering. The event was incepted way back in 2006. It encompasses several technical events designed to bring out the communication, organizational, literary and technical skills of the students.

## Events

## Event Guidelines

- Students are requested toregisterfor the events and showcase their communication and design abilities.
- Certificates of Participation will be awarded to all participants.
- Prizes will be given away to the winners.
